lines.trans: Sports were actually my true calling all along.
I used to come here all the time in the past.
Every time I came here, I felt especially happy and relaxed.
Yet once I entered the television industry, I never had time for it anymore.
Things are pretty great now, since I can come every single day.
Is everyone back at the company doing alright?
That is good to hear.
On the platform you built, employees are bound to grow well.
Some things in life simply have to be faced.
Hello, Mr Chun Yuqiao.
This is Bu Xiaogu.
I would like to come check on you.

主业.gloss: main profession, primary line of business

meanings.en: main profession, primary line of business
meanings.note: Contrasts one's core work with side pursuits.

examples.text: 内容制作始终是这家传媒公司的主业。

examples.text: 他开玩笑说攀岩才是自己的主业。
